description: tangent-outside-cut's tool moved into the plate by a tolerance (1e-7), or turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a quarter of one in and out. Arris fails: a piece with no interior point at its clearance (Fault::Split, NoInterior; the offset), a fit of the section of the face's plane and the tool's wall that still deviates past the tolerance at its most spans (Fault::Geometry; the quarter turn). The desired result is a clean cut: the plate within the tolerance, the plate less a sliver beyond. The half turn now passes and is boolean/tangent-outside-cut-band-ends' (plans/c3-tolerance-apart steps 1 and 9, the band survey)
